mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.25% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that increases discount rates on equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.25%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (HOUST) above 1,350,000 units signals strong household demand and confidence, which drives higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1350.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a contraction in real economic activity, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in CPIAUCSL above 3.5% year-over-year, combined with a stable federal funds rate, indicates inflation persistence that forces the Fed to delay rate cuts, increasing real rates and depressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 720,000 million dollars, combined with rising industrial production, signals strong aggregate demand that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS and INDPRO both rise, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs per month, combined with a falling unemployment rate, signals a labor market overheating that increases inflationary pressures and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 200.0 and UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) above 2.5% annualized, combined with rising residential investment (HOUST), signals strong underlying economic momentum that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 and HOUST both rise, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
